player_id: Stable MLB person ID; join to the pitcher archive using this ID.
position_reported: Source-reported position abbreviation; not a reconstructed historical position log.
games: Source-reported player games; may include games with no batting. Player-season uses independent all-team official count.
singles: H minus doubles, triples and home runs.
rbi: Runs batted in; excludes some runs scored.
walks: All bases on balls (BB), including intentional.
pitches_seen: Number of pitches reported in hitting stats. Not part of counting-field reconciliation.
source_url: Exact MLB query associated with this record.
ops: OBP + SLG, calculated before rounding; blank if either undefined.
sb_success_pct: SB/(SB+CS); stored as a fraction, blank when no attempts.
league_obp: Aggregate MLB OBP in the same season.
league_slg: Aggregate MLB SLG in the same season.
rating_sample_weight: PA/(PA+200); shrinkage coefficient, not a confidence probability.
team_split_games_sum: Sum of the player-team-season games fields; retained beside official season games.
team_count: Distinct team IDs within row scope.
team_ids: Semicolon-separated team IDs, not chronological order.
teams: Semicolon-separated team names; count of clubs in validation table.
first_observed_season: Earliest record year inside the requested window.
last_observed_season: Latest record year inside the requested window.
seasons_with_records: Number of distinct seasons with source records.
seasons_with_PA: Number of distinct seasons with positive plate appearances.
boundary_start: First observed year equals requested start year.
boundary_end: Last observed year equals requested end year.
rated_plate_appearances: PA represented by nonblank underlying annual ratings.
weighted_offensive_index: PA-weighted mean of valid underlying annual or team-season ratings.
team_names_observed: Unique names associated with team ID inside this row scope.
observed_run_number: Chronological sequence of consecutive record-year runs for player/team.
latest_observed_offensive_index: Index for latest record season in the archive, not current ability.
best_season_by_index: Season with highest valid index; no separate PA qualification.
player_games_sum: Sum of player game counts; NOT actual team games.
players_with_records: Player records contributing to a club-season.
team_games: Official club games from the team endpoint, summed across years in team overview.
runs_per_game: Runs scored divided by actual team games.
team_totals_source_url: Independent team-total query used to verify this club-season.
players: Unique players with records in the validation season.
player_team_rows: Number of player-team-season rows in the validation season.
counting_fields_reconciled: Number of offensive counting fields checked against independent totals.
player_totals_reconcile: True after every player-season matches across checked fields.
team_totals_reconcile: True after all club-season totals match independent team source across checked fields.
